{{Top|leg}}
'''Homar's Hotels''' were a chain of [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] that could be found throughout the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. There was a Homar's Hotel on every level of [[Byblos Starport Tower 214]]. They offered cheap but clean rooms.
